_readme: Preview scene fixups. See ldd-lili-collection.json for the format.

_why: Dawnbreaker's card drew the honest cross and the item looked broken
(field 2026-08-10). It was not the FX skip, which is what the parked
note assumed. The whole sword is parented under a node literally
named Dummy, and dummy is one of the census-derived helper tokens
matched against the FULL name path, so every geometry in the file
was dropped: the log reads filtered=10/0 and then failed(geometry).
The four real pieces are dawnbreaker:0, dawnbreaker:1, gem:1 and
A show beats the helper-token rule, which is exactly the over-match
this mechanism exists for. The patterns end at a colon rather than
at a bare star on purpose: dawnbreaker* would also match
dawnbreakerswordfx01, and those glow planes are correctly skipped as
FX. They draw additively through a shader path the thumbnail pass
does not have, and unskipped they photographed as an opaque cream
Scoped to this one model rather than narrowing the dummy token
globally, because a token change moves pixels on cards whose keys
cannot tell the difference, and a scope tag re-keys exactly the card
it covers. That is also what clears this card's persisted failure.
